title: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBasisAcyclicSections_preservesLeftHomology
statement: For an integer-indexed complex F on a scheme X and an open affine V, if positive cohomology of every differential cokernel and every homology sheaf restricts to affine opens W contained in V vanishes, evaluation on V preserves the left homology data of F in every degree. The complex and module sheaves are those of [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; cohomology is [def-sc-sheaf-cohomology-functor] and the scheme is [def-pc-scheme].

proof.text: Translate underlying abelian-sheaf vanishing to module right-derived sections using the source comparison.

The finite short exact sequences H^r(F) -> coker(d^(r-1)) -> im(d^r) and im(d^(r-1)) -> cycles^r -> H^r(F) show boundaries and cycles acyclic. Module cohomology uses enough injectives and the full long exact sequence.
The initial exact sequence makes evaluation of the boundary quotient and cycle quotient epi; preservation of kernels and the resulting cokernel universal property give preservation of left homology.

theorem affineBasisAcyclicSections_preservesLeftHomology
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (F : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ)
    (hcokernels : ∀ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → W ≤ V → ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : ℕ),
      Subsingleton (((cokernel (F.d (n - 1) n)).restrict W.ι).H (q + 1)))
    (hhomology : ∀ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → W ≤ V → ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : ℕ),
      Subsingleton (((F.homology n).restrict W.ι).H (q + 1))) (n : ℤ) :
    let S := SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (op V)
    letI : S.Additive := inferInstanceAs
      ((SheafOfModules.forget.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj (op V)).Additive)
    S.PreservesLeftHomologyOf (F.sc n)
